F-duck-drive-0016.name: Unnamed wetland by St. Mary River
F-duck-drive-0016.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
F-duck-drive-0016.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed paved road

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 5.9 ha, 30 m from the road.
About 3 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside a river: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

flags.t: CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-20: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 4. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 87 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.78377, -116.5972, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 30 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-20, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 91 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via King St W, King St, Wycliffe Rd, Perry Creek Rd.
Park: 49.83919, -116.5976, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 280 m to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.1 km one way. About 62 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-20, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
